description:
Give the tuning-campaign tooling one shared way to resolve the repository root at runtime.

## Background

`@/inv/no-dev-path-coupling` requires development artifacts to be located by content identity or through one configured repository root resolved at runtime. The tooling resolves the root through several private copies of the same `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` call: `dev/tools/tuning-campaign-support/tests/driver_launcher.rs`, `tests/addendum_schema_versions.rs`, the benchmark A/B runner, and the tuning-extent campaign driver. `tests/protocol_contracts.rs` still uses a depth-dependent `../../..` path.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `tuning-campaign-support` exposes one public function that resolves the repository root at runtime, and every binary and test in the crate uses it in place of a private copy.
- [hard] REQ-02: No depth-dependent relative path to the repository root remains in the crate's binaries or tests.
- [hard] REQ-03: Every test result and committed receipt verdict is unchanged, and the Rust CI gate passes.
title: Share one repository-root resolver across tuning-campaign tooling
